settings.capacity_basis: Assumed common study service envelope; not verified VVTS declared capacity
settings.motion_scope: Native airborne paths from assumed sector admission / runway departure to touchdown / route exit
settings.assumptions_basis: User-authorized synthetic schedules, origins, status, capacity and control domains
settings.point_merge_policy: Assumed direct from the first native fan fix to its merge; identical rule in both cases
settings.wake_model: Wake labels retained; uniform synthetic runway headway, no type-specific wake model
settings.budget_basis: Objective calls include shared ground greedy preparation and GA initialization
settings.objective: C + lambda * (15-min excess + rolling-hour excess + spatial pairs + new spatial pairs + runway pairs + transfer pairs)

limitations: User-authorized synthetic case study derived from workbook populations. Dates, origins and departure status are model inputs.
Each source row is assumed to request one runway event in a one-hour demand window. The workbook does not supply event times.
Source snapshot coordinates and pseudo-routes are replaced with the native 25R arrival / 25L departure model.
Upstream routes use the saved historical airway geometry. Sector admission, FL300, speeds and route direction are assumptions.
Unregulated reference: separation violations remain visible. No FCFS repair, GA or ATFM benefit is claimed.
Origin takeoff/offblock times and a 30-minute origin-to-admission transit are synthetic. That external transit and taxi geometry are not replayed.
Shared clear weather, nominal type-independent motion and assumed capacity; no operational validation is claimed.
The same assumed early point-merge direct-to policy is used in both cases; candidate paths are still checked for separation.
Full-route GA uses physical Centre speed metering and predeparture holds; remaining violations are reported explicitly.
All study inputs are synthetic. Feasible_sampled is a model diagnostic, not operational validation.
Search uses 20 s samples; selected plans are checked at 1 s on interpolated native 5 s paths.
Only the explicit upstream sector-to-endpoint geometry is replayed; external origin transit is a timing assumption.
